string.text: Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Reinforced frame
Reinforcing the standard plastic pistol frame helps reduce the deformation experienced by plastic parts when fired, thereby extending the service life of the weapon.
Combined tactical module
Combines the functions of a highly targeted tactical flashlight and a laser target designator.Particularly useful at night.
Lightweight magazine
Allows you to slightly reduce the weight of the weapon.
Refinement of the extractor
Allows you to reduce the number of delays associated with the sticking of cartridges ejected from the pistol after firing.It has a beneficial effect on the reliability of the weapon.
Adjusting the locking mechanism
By locking the bore more tightly, the obturation of the bore improves and the muzzle velocity of the bullet increases.
Recoil compensator
The recoil compensation system integrated into the bolt design makes shooting more comfortable and accurate.
Refinement of the chamber
Allows you to achieve higher shooting accuracy.
Muffler thread
Replacing the barrel with an elongated one, with a thread designed to install a silencer for 9x19 mm caliber.
Barrel with modified rifling pitch
Allows you to increase the initial speed of the bullet.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to make shooting from weapons more accurate.
Forcing USM
Reconfiguring the trigger and modifying some of its parts allows the shooter to fire at a higher rate.Unfortunately, this causes the weapon to wear out a little faster.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to internal parts helps slow down the wear of the weapon.
Soft trigger trigger
Allows you to reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
Anatomical handle
Selecting and installing grip pads that are more suitable for a particular shooter on a weapon allows you to achieve better results when shooting.
Heavy Duty Parts
They have a higher resistance to wear, making the weapon more reliable.
